name: Spellcasting
description: Cast Wizard spells using Intelligence. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 4 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

descriptions.2: Cast Wizard spells using Intelligence. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 5 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.
descriptions.3: Cast Wizard spells using Intelligence. You know 3 cantrips and prepare 6 spells of level 1 or 2. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. After a Long Rest, you can replace your prepared spells. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

name: Ritual Adept
description: You can cast any spell as a ritual if it has the Ritual tag and it is in your spellbook. You need not have the spell prepared.

name: Arcane Recovery
description: Once per Long Rest, when you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots. The total level of the recovered slots cannot exceed half your Wizard level (rounded up). None of the recovered slots can be level 6 or higher.

name: Scholar
description: Choose Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion in which you have proficiency. Gain Expertise in that skill.

name: Evocation Savant
description: Add two Wizard Evocation spells of level 1 or 2 to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain access to a new level of Wizard spell slots, add one eligible Evocation spell to the book for free.

name: Potent Cantrip
description: When you cast a damaging cantrip at a creature and miss with the attack roll or it succeeds on its save, it takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) with no additional effect.
